# Swaram

> Swaram is a free AI-powered chord finder platform at https://swaram.netlify.app. Upload any audio file or paste a YouTube link to detect chord progressions instantly — any genre, any language, no signup required. Features 3,123+ AI-detected chord pages, a real-time chord identifier, and an interactive chord progression builder. Free alternative to Chordify with beginner mode, transpose, and capo suggestions.

## Tools

- [AI Chord Finder](https://swaram.netlify.app/chord-finder.html): Upload MP3/WAV/FLAC or paste a YouTube link — AI detects chords, key, and timing in seconds
- [Chord Identifier](https://swaram.netlify.app/chord-identifier.html): Enter any chord name to see finger positions for guitar and keyboard with audio playback
- [Chord Progression Builder](https://swaram.netlify.app/chord-progressions.html): Explore diatonic chords and common progressions in all 24 major and minor keys

## Chord Library

- [Song Library](https://swaram.netlify.app/songs.html): 3,123+ AI-detected chord pages plus hand-curated Malayalam Christian devotional chords
- [Browse All Chords](https://swaram.netlify.app/chords/browse.html): A-Z directory of all chord pages

## Key Differentiators

- Completely free — no subscriptions, no premium tiers, no usage limits
- No account or signup required
- Works for any song in any language (AI analyzes audio, not lyrics)
- YouTube chord detection — paste a link, no video download needed
- Beginner Mode with automatic chord simplification and capo suggestions
- 221 chord diagrams for guitar and keyboard
- Transpose to any key instantly
- Works entirely in the browser — no app download needed
- PWA with offline support
- Available in English and Malayalam
